mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has risen for at least 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1900 thousand units, it indicates weakening residential construction activity that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1900.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and decreases in CPIAUCSL indicate successful inflation control without recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations adjust to lower real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion with UNRATE below 4.5%, labor market overheating triggers aggressive Fed rate hikes that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has risen for at least 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real retail sales (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines and GDPC1 growth slows, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion with RSAFS rising above 0.5% month-over-month and GDPC1 growth exceeding 1.5% annualized, accelerating consumer spending momentum drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises above 0.5% and GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5% annualized, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
